title: Technology Selection
text:
Technology choices should consider requirements, scalability,
performance, reliability, security, development speed, ecosystem,
available expertise, maintenance cost and integration complexity.
The newest technology is not automatically the best choice.

title: Build Versus Buy
text:
Build-versus-buy decisions should compare development cost,
time to deployment, customization requirements, vendor dependency,
maintenance, security and long-term total cost of ownership.
Buying can reduce implementation time, while building can provide
greater control when requirements are highly specialized.

title: Skill Investment
text:
When choosing what skill to learn, consider relevance to
the target role, current proficiency, learning difficulty,
practical application, transferability and expected demand.
Projects that demonstrate the skill can increase the value
of learning compared with theoretical study alone.

title: Business Strategy
text:
Business decisions should consider customer value,
competitive advantage, market demand, operational feasibility,
financial impact, scalability and execution risk.

title: Cost Benefit Analysis
text:
Cost-benefit analysis compares the total costs of an action
against its expected benefits. Costs and benefits should be
considered together with assumptions, uncertainty, time horizon
and opportunity cost.
